ideas.title: Set the brushes for the load: Lumi's hand on the rocker while the motor hauls
ideas.goal: The player, as Lumi, grips the brush rocker of the drum motor with its hand and turns it while the motor hauls the empty cart on its rope; the sparks fade and the rope speeds up at one angle, and that angle moves as the cart climbs and the current rises, so you keep setting it by eye and ear like an old dynamo hand.
ideas.toward: The cart's motor working under the cart's real load, and the big goal's dusk spark, both from the same circuit.
ideas.idea: Nothing typed in: each coil is its own circuit branch with its own L(θ, I1, I2) and flux linkage tabulated from SATURATING Ferrite solves over rotor angle AND both coil currents (so armature reaction, the load-shifted neutral, comes out of the field solve), the brushes are contact patches of real width whose overlap with each segment sets the contact resistance as they slide, a coil shorted by a brush reverses its current with its own L/R, and whatever is left when the brush leaves goes into the spark (1/2 L i^2). The rocker is a part Lumi's hand holds (Jump in: grab, turn). The load is the real rope to the cart (next idea), so the best angle moves by itself. Watching: Lumi's hand on the rocker, sparks fading from bright to a faint violet as the rope speeds up.
ideas.form: physics (per-coil commutation + current-dependent field tables in physics/motor2d.jl and motor.jl) + Jump in grab-and-turn on the rocker + a traced dusk film from Lumi's shoulder

ideas.title: The winch: hook anything, it hauls or stalls
ideas.goal: The player hooks the motor's rope to anything on the island (a log, a crate, the empty cart, a friend on the cart) and picks a pulley; the motor hauls it or stalls by what it weighs and how it rolls, and the stall shows: rope taut, drum stopped, the brushes sparking bright on the stall current.
ideas.toward: The first time the car's motor moves the car; the cart's mass and rolling are the cart's own.
ideas.idea: No speeds quoted or fitted: the rope is a PrintSim rod chain with IPC contact wrapping the oak rope drum and a pulley, the cart a PrintSim affine body with its mass from mesh volume x density (todo #745) and its wheels rolling on the plank meshes by contact, the motor's torque from its circuit each step (back-EMF, pots' internal resistance) applied to the rope drum's joint. Gear ratio = which pulley the player puts on. What you see is what the coupled solve gives: a creep, a stall, a slip.
ideas.form: plugin coupling motor.jl to PrintSim bodies by the plank track + traced film following the rope from the sparking drum to the cart

ideas.title: Wind the coil with your own hands
ideas.goal: Lumi lays copper wire round the iron drum turn by turn with its hand; neat turns make a strong, smooth motor, sloppy bunched turns make it weak and lopsided so it shakes on its block, and the player can see why in the winding itself.
ideas.toward: The motor built part by part from what Lumi made; a road step the cart's motor rests on.
ideas.idea: The wire is a PrintSim rod Lumi's hand pulls and lays (it bends, keeps its bends, collides with the drum and the turns already there); when the winding is done, the 2D Ferrite solve takes the ACTUAL cross-section of the conductors where the rod lies in each slot (no N scaling), its resistance from the rod's real length, its unbalance (more turns one side) as a rotating force the drum's bearings feel. The motor then runs from that table.
ideas.form: Jump in task at the drum + physics coupling rod -> field solve + close traced still of the winding

ideas.title: Fit the bearings: it binds or it runs
ideas.goal: The player fits the drum's axle into two oak bearings and shims them with slivers of wood until it spins freely; a bearing pushed out of line pinches the axle and the motor on six pots cannot start it, one shim too many and it rattles.
ideas.toward: A machine assembled from parts that works only when the parts fit; the cart's axles come next with the same physics.
ideas.idea: The axle, bearing blocks and shims are PrintSim bodies with IPC contact; the friction torque the motor must overcome is the contact normal force from misalignment times the measured wood-on-iron friction, not a typed mu_bearing. Lumi's hand places shims; the motor's start or stall comes from the coupled circuit and contact solve.
ideas.form: Jump in assembly at the drum + physics (contacts in bearings) + a still of the fitted bearing

ideas.title: The cart's oak frame takes the friends' weight
ideas.goal: The player builds the cart's frame from oak planks and pegs, picks thickness and braces, and three friends climb aboard: a frame too thin sags until a peg splits, a braced one holds and barely bends; you learn to build light but strong because the motor has to pull every gram.
ideas.toward: Road step 'wheels, axle and a wooden frame': the frame the motor and accumulator will sit on.
ideas.idea: PrintSim FEM with multigrid on each plank (oak's real anisotropic stiffness and strength along and across the grain), pegs as joints that fail past their shear strength, the friends as bodies with real mass standing on it; the sag, creak and split come from stress, the frame's mass goes into the winch's load.
ideas.form: Jump in building at the workshop + physics (FEM frame) + traced film of friends climbing on

ideas.title: A compass needle that reads the current
ideas.goal: The player winds a few turns of wire round a beach-stone box with a magnetised needle on a thorn inside, puts it in the motor's cord, and reads the current on its swing; it becomes the cart's only gauge, and you learn to read a stall, a weak pot or a good brush setting from how it swings.
ideas.toward: The cart's dashboard, made from parts on the island: how the player will see charge and load on the cart.
ideas.idea: A tangent galvanometer: em.jl's field of the actual coil turns at the needle plus the island's own magnetic field, the needle a rigid magnet on a pivot with its inertia and air damping; it swings, overshoots and settles by its own dynamics, and kicks on every spark.
ideas.form: physics (em.jl field + needle dynamics) + plugin by the drum + close traced still
